```{r}
intron14_15_alltissues <- normalsplicing_ENST00000231790_long_tissue %>% dplyr::filter(donor_exon == 15 | acceptor_exon == 15)
```

```{r}
combined_alltissues_exon15 <- bind_rows(intron14_15_alltissues, exon15skip_alltissues)
combined_alltissues_ordered_exon15 <- combined_alltissues_exon15 %>%
  mutate(order_rank = case_when(
    end.x == 37042267 ~ 1,
    start.x == 	37042332 ~ 2,
    skipped_exons == 1 ~ 3,
    TRUE ~ 4
  )) %>%
  arrange(rail_id, order_rank) %>%
  dplyr::select(-order_rank)
# order the events : per rail_id, first row is intron 11 split read count, second row is intron 12 split read count, third row is exon 12 split read count

combined_alltissues_ordered_exon15 <- combined_alltissues_ordered_exon15 %>% dplyr::select(start.x, end.x, junction_id, donor_exon, acceptor_exon, event_class, rail_id, SUBJID, counts, SMTSD, SEX, AGE, bc_auc.all_reads_annotated_bases, external_id, `star.uniquely_mapped_reads_%_both`, junction_count)
# select only the required columns to make the dataframe simpler

combined_alltissues_ordered_exon15 <- combined_alltissues_ordered_exon15 %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(SUBJID))

# remove the rows where SUBJID is NA (these are all leukemic cell samples or from studyNA, no other tissues)
```

```{r}
template_exon15 <- tibble::tibble(
  junction_id = c(21496486, 21496585, 21496495),
  start.x = c(37040295, 37042332, 37040295),
  end.x   = c(37042267, 37047518, 37047518),
  donor_exon = c(14, 15, 14),
  acceptor_exon = c(15, 16, 16),
  event_class = c("normal splicing", "normal splicing", "exon skipping")
)

rail_meta_exon15 <- combined_alltissues_ordered_exon15 %>%
  distinct(rail_id, SMTSD)
# how many unique samples are in combined_tissues_ordered (is the same as how many rail_id's are in combined_tissues_ordered)

expected_rows_exon15 <- rail_meta_exon15 %>%
  crossing(template_exon15)
# in expected, every rail_id has three columns
# for each unique sample in combined_tissues_ordered (is in rail_meta) i want 3 columns : 1 with intron 11 splicing, intron 12 splicing and exon 12 skipping -> expected contains all the junction_id x rail_id combinations i want to see in my final dataframe

existing_rows_exon15 <- combined_alltissues_ordered_exon15 %>%
  distinct(
    rail_id,
    junction_id
  ) %>%
  mutate(exists = TRUE)

# so which junction_id x rail_id combinations exist in the dataframe i already have -> is in existing keys -> i want to add the difference in junction_id x rail_id combinations between expected and existing keys to combined_tissues_ordered

rows_to_add_exon15 <- expected_rows_exon15 %>%
  left_join(existing_rows_exon15,
            by = c("rail_id", "junction_id")) %>%
  filter(is.na(exists)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-exists) %>%
  mutate(counts = 0)
# in this code the missing junction_id x rail_id combinations are identified and stored in to_add

combined_alltissues_ordered_complete_exon15 <- bind_rows(combined_alltissues_ordered_exon15, rows_to_add_exon15)

#adding the missing rows to combined_tissues_ordered
# at this point, all the rows required are present
```

```{r}
onerow_per_sample1_exon15 <- combined_alltissues_ordered_complete_exon15 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(rail_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_inclusion = sum(
      counts[junction_type == "14_15"] +
      counts[junction_type == "15_16"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    skipping = counts[junction_type == "14_16"],
    SEX = SEX[!is.na(SEX)][1],
    AGE = AGE[!is.na(AGE)][1],
    SUBJID = SUBJID[!is.na(SUBJID)][1],
    SMTSD = SMTSD[!is.na(SMTSD)][1],
    bc_auc.all_reads_annotated_bases =
      bc_auc.all_reads_annotated_bases[!is.na(bc_auc.all_reads_annotated_bases)][1],
    external_id = external_id[!is.na(external_id)][1],
    `star.uniquely_mapped_reads_%_both` = `star.uniquely_mapped_reads_%_both`[!is.na(`star.uniquely_mapped_reads_%_both`)][1],
    junction_count = junction_count[!is.na(junction_count)][1],
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )

onerow_per_sample2_exon15 <- combined_alltissues_ordered_complete_exon15 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(rail_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    inc_14_15 = sum(counts[junction_type == "14_15"], na.rm = TRUE),
    inc_15_16 = sum(counts[junction_type == "15_16"], na.rm = TRUE),
    skipping  = sum(counts[junction_type == "14_16"], na.rm = TRUE),

    SEX = SEX[!is.na(SEX)][1],
    AGE = AGE[!is.na(AGE)][1],
    SUBJID = SUBJID[!is.na(SUBJID)][1],
    SMTSD = SMTSD[!is.na(SMTSD)][1],
    bc_auc.all_reads_annotated_bases =
      bc_auc.all_reads_annotated_bases[!is.na(bc_auc.all_reads_annotated_bases)][1],
    external_id = external_id[!is.na(external_id)][1],
    `star.uniquely_mapped_reads_%_both` =
      `star.uniquely_mapped_reads_%_both`[!is.na(`star.uniquely_mapped_reads_%_both`)][1],
    junction_count = junction_count[!is.na(junction_count)][1],

    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
onerow_per_sample1_collapsed_exon15 <- onerow_per_sample1_exon15 %>%
  mutate(
    SAMPLE_ID = external_id %>%
      sub("\\.\\d+$", "", .) %>%         # remove .1 / .2
      sub("-SM-.*$", "", .) %>%          # remove SM and everything after
      sub("^(GTEX-[^-]+-[^-]+(?:-[^-]+)?).*", "\\1", .)
  )
```

```{r}
# filtered model with all the covariats
model_tmb_exon15_filtered_covariats <- glmmTMB(
  cbind(skipping, total_inclusion) ~ 
    SMTSD + 
    SEX + 
    AGE +
    scale(bc_auc.all_reads_annotated_bases) +
    scale(`star.uniquely_mapped_reads_%_both`) +
    scale(junction_count) +
    scale(mlh1_cpm) + 
    (1 | SUBJID),
  
  family = betabinomial(),
  data = merged_selected_tissues_subset1_exon15_filtered
)

emm_tmb_exon15_filtered_covariats <- emmeans(model_tmb_exon15_filtered_covariats, ~ SMTSD)
pairs_tmb_exon15_filtered_covariats <- pairs(emm_tmb_exon15_filtered_covariats, adjust = "BH")
model_tmb_exon15_filtered_covariats
pairs_tmb_exon15_filtered_covariats
```
```{r}
emm_thisplot_exon15_filtered_covariats <- emmeans(model_tmb_exon15_filtered_covariats, ~ SMTSD, type = "response")
emm_thisplot_exon15_filtered_covariats_df <- as.data.frame(emm_thisplot_exon15_filtered_covariats)
breast_prob_exon15_filtered_covariats <- emm_thisplot_exon15_filtered_covariats_df$prob[emm_thisplot_exon15_filtered_covariats_df$SMTSD == "Breast - Mammary Tissue"]

emm_thisplot_exon15_filtered_covariats_df <- emm_thisplot_exon15_filtered_covariats_df %>%
  mutate(
    fold_vs_breast = breast_prob_exon15_filtered_covariats / prob
  )
```

```{r}
exon15_dist_exact_base1 <- merged_selected_tissues_subset1_exon15 %>%
  mutate(
    skipping_capped = ifelse(skipping >= 10, "10+", as.character(skipping))
  ) %>%
  group_by(SMTSD, skipping_capped) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(SMTSD) %>%
  mutate(
    total_tissue = sum(n),
    pct = 100 * n / total_tissue
  )

ggplot(
  exon15_dist_exact_base1,
  aes(
    x = factor(skipping_capped,
               levels = c(as.character(0:9), "10+")),
    y = pct
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 1.0) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct)),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ SMTSD) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Exon 15 skipping read count",
    y = "Percentage of samples within tissue"
  ) +
  ylim(0, max(exon15_dist_exact_base1$pct) * 1.1)
```
```{r}
exon15_dist_exact_base2 <- merged_selected_tissues_subset1_exon15 %>%
  mutate(
    psi_sum = skipping / (skipping + total_inclusion),
    psi_bin = cut(
      psi_sum,
      breaks = c(
        0,
        0.001,
        0.005,
        0.01,
        0.02,
        0.05,
        0.1,
        0.2,
        1
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(SMTSD, psi_bin) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(SMTSD) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n))

ggplot(exon15_dist_exact_base2, aes(x = psi_bin, y = pct)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 1) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct)),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ SMTSD) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 5, angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "PSI bin",
    y = "Percentage of samples within tissue"
  ) +
  ylim(0, max(exon15_dist_exact_base2$pct) * 1.1)
```
```{r}
pairs_tmb_exon15_base_df_nonlog <- as.data.frame(pairs_tmb_exon15_base)

# Filter Breast comparisons
pairs_tmb_exon15_base_df_nonlog <- pairs_tmb_exon15_base_df_nonlog %>%
  filter(grepl("Breast - Mammary Tissue", contrast))

# Compute effects + significance + modified labels
pairs_tmb_exon15_base_df_nonlog <- pairs_tmb_exon15_base_df_nonlog %>%
  mutate(
    odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
    percent_difference = (odds_ratio - 1) * 100,
    lower_ci = (exp(estimate - 1.96 * SE) - 1) * 100,
    upper_ci = (exp(estimate + 1.96 * SE) - 1) * 100,

    sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),

    # clean tissue label + add stars
    tissue = gsub(".*Breast - Mammary Tissue - ", "", contrast),
    tissue = paste0(tissue, sig)
  )

# Plot with stars in labels
ggplot(pairs_tmb_exon15_base_df_nonlog,
       aes(x = percent_difference, y = reorder(tissue, percent_difference))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = lower_ci, xmax = upper_ci),
    height = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Percent difference in exon skipping odds vs Breast",
    y = "Tissue"
  )
```
```{r}
emm_resp_exon15_base <- summary(emm_tmb_exon15_base, type = "response")
emm_resp_exon15_base_df <- as.data.frame(emm_resp_exon15_base)
ggplot(emm_resp_exon15_base_df, aes(x = reorder(SMTSD, prob), y = prob)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL), width = 0.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Tissue",
    y = "Predicted exon skipping proportion",
    title = "MLH1 exon skipping across tissues"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
model_tmb_exon15_base_intron15 <- glmmTMB(
  cbind(skipping, inc_15_16) ~ 
    SMTSD + 
    SEX + 
    AGE +
    (1 | SUBJID),
  
  family = betabinomial(),
  data = merged_selected_tissues_subset2_exon15
)

emm_tmb_exon15_base_intron15 <- emmeans(model_tmb_exon15_base_intron15, ~ SMTSD)
pairs_tmb_exon15_base_intron15 <- pairs(emm_tmb_exon15_base_intron15, adjust = "BH")
model_tmb_exon15_base_intron15
pairs_tmb_exon15_base_intron15
```
```{r}
emm_thisplot_exon15_base_intron15 <- emmeans(model_tmb_exon15_base_intron15, ~ SMTSD, type = "response")
emm_thisplot_exon15_base_intron15_df <- as.data.frame(emm_thisplot_exon15_base_intron15)
breast_prob_exon15_base_intron15 <- emm_thisplot_exon15_base_intron15_df$prob[emm_thisplot_exon15_base_intron15_df$SMTSD == "Breast - Mammary Tissue"]

emm_thisplot_exon15_base_intron15_df <- emm_thisplot_exon15_base_intron15_df %>%
  mutate(
    fold_vs_breast = breast_prob_exon15_base_intron15 / prob
  )
emm_thisplot_exon15_base_intron15_df
```
